pick.headline: Communist coup in Afghanistan (the Saur Revolution)
pick.fbis: The Middle East & North Africa Daily Report of April 28, 1978, carried Paris AFP from Islamabad: Kabul radio announced President Daud overthrown by an armed forces revolutionary council after fighting with tanks and MiG jets around the palace.
